          "text": "Extract the following details from the message below:

- TransactionID
- Amount
- Sender (if money received)
- Recipient (if money sent)
- Date
- Time
- Balance
- TransactionCost

Special Rule:
- If the message contains the word 'Give', treat it as a deposit (received), and extract sender details. Set recipient as 'NIL'.
- If money was received, extract sender and set recipient as 'NIL'.
- If money was sent, extract recipient and set sender as 'NIL'.

Return the result in this exact JSON format:

```json
{
  "TransactionID": "...",
  "Amount": ...,
  "Sender": "...",
  "Recipient": "...",
  "Date": "...",
  "Time": "...",
  "Balance": ...,
  "TransactionCost": ...
}
```

{{ $json.snippet }}"
